def_en: 1) to cut, cut off, cut down, cut off a body part, cut out, eliminate, kill, cut a covenant
1a1a) to cut off a body part, behead
1a4) to cut or make a covenant
kjv: be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), [idiom] lose, perish, [idiom] utterly, [idiom] want.
expl: to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces)
